# Doit Then 0.1.8
- Rebrand the app to **Doit Then** while preserving the previously approved app icon. - Add local groups for Apple Reminders lists, with collapse/expand and aggregate group views. - Add inline **New List** and **New Group** creation. - Add list/group drag organization, including moving lists into and out of groups and reordering groups. - Add inline rename and delete actions for lists and groups. Deleting a group keeps its lists. - Add global Undo/Redo for sidebar organization and list/group rename operations. - Smooth sidebar drag settling and animated Undo/Redo.
